description: This is a Flutter controller class (`ContentDetailsController`) managing state and interactions for content details view, including loading content, handling cache updates, playback progress, watchlist management, and download status.

classes.name: ContentDetailsController
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier-based controller managing content detail state, including loading content, watchlist, download status, and playback progress.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads content details, watch progress, watchlist status, and download info, updating internal state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: toggleWatchlist
methods.description: Adds or removes the current content ID to/from the watchlist stored in cache.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Re-initiates loading content details to update UI with cache updates.

methods.name: playPressed
methods.description: Handles play/resume action by updating playback position.

methods.name: updateProgressSeconds
methods.description: Updates and persists playback progress in the repository and UI.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: Backwards-compatible method to record playback position.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Marks playback as completed and resets last watched seconds.

methods.name: markDownloadEnqueuedLocally
methods.description: Immediately updates UI to reflect that download has been enqueued.
